title: The EU AI Act just changed everything for tech companies

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The EU AI Act just forced big tech to slow down — and it’s already shaking up the industry.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This law is shaping the future of AI in Europe, and it’s here now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s a new rule requiring high-risk AI systems to be transparent and safe.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: One key detail: companies must label AI-generated content in ads and social media.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Big tech, startups, and even influencers are now under strict new scrutiny.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The takeaway? AI isn’t just innovation — it’s now regulated like medicine.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how this will change the tech world? Hit follow for the breakdown.
